name: scrapeunblocker
description: Scrape any web page through the ScrapeUnblocker anti-bot API (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, Shape). Adds an MCP server with fetch_html, fetch_markdown, fetch_parsed, google_search, search_and_read and 100+ site plugins (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Google Maps, YouTube, Zillow and more), a /scrape-url command, and 8 skills: page HTML and Markdown, AI-parsed structured data, Google SERP results, ready-made plugin data (Skyscanner, eBay, Google Local), the MCP server, competitive & market intelligence, shopping price comparison, and integration best practices.
